verdict.rationale: The evidence describes the Guichet unique filing flow only through logged-in mechanisms: connecting via FranceConnect+, dashboards for managing created formalities, and tracking submitted deposits. No published page documents a way to start a filing without an account, whether keyless or by file number. The keyless probe concerns a separate state company-data API, not this filing service, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start the core online flow without creating an account first — the service's published pages document a keyless or file-number entry path
